title: stevia hirsuta var. chortiana
intro: Stevia hirsuta var. chortiana, commonly known as Andean stevia, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae) and is native to the Andean regions of South America. It has been used for its health benefits, which include lowering blood sugar levels, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Andean stevia include its potential use as an antihypertensive and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a promising treatment for hypertension and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Andean stevia include steviol glycosides, including rebaudioside A, which is responsible for its sweet taste and medicinal properties.
